compass-compass-datacenters-illinois-cam.note: I read the Illinois EPA project summary and draft permit for Compass Datacenters ORD I at 3333 Beverly Road, Hoffman Estates (application 23110012, June 2024). It lists 200 diesel generators of 2,000 kWe and 5 of 1,250 kWe, 406.25 MW in all. No final permit is on record, so the status is announced.

aligned-aligned-data-centers-illinois-ca.note: Aligned has two Illinois campuses with permits. At Elk Grove Village, a final permit of August 14, 2025 covers 112 diesel generators of 3,000 kWe, 336 MW (this record). At Northlake, a final permit of October 4, 2021 covers 49 generators of 3,000 kW and 2 of 500 kW, 148 MW, staged as the separate record us-il:new:aligned-northlake-data-center-power-station.

edged-dekalb-project-vector.note: This lead was not on the worklist. I searched the Illinois EPA air notice list (no record for Edged or Endeavor), DeKalb news and trade press. A WTVO article of December 2, 2025 names TurboCell natural gas generators for Project Vector and gives no rating. I found no capacity, so it is staged as an add with capacity blank.

cyrusone-aurora.note: I read the final Title V permit of July 21, 2026 for CyrusOne at 2905 E. Diehl Road, Aurora. It lists 91 diesel emergency generators from 1,250 to 2,750 kW that add up to 211.25 MW.

meta-dekalb.note: I searched the Illinois EPA air notice archive (2,165 records) for Meta, Facebook and DeKalb data center permits and found none. News says the DeKalb campus is open with five buildings. No generator list, count or rating was found in any source.

t5-data-centers-grayslake.note: I searched the Illinois EPA air notice archive for a Grayslake data center permit and found none. The T5 permits in the archive are for Elk Grove Village. News describes a 1.2 GW campus planned for 2027 with grid power and says nothing about generators.

microsoft-hoffman-estates.note: I searched the Illinois EPA air notice archive for Microsoft permits at Hoffman Estates and found none. News from 2021 covers the village approval of two buildings on the former AT and T campus and names no generators. The Compass permit at 3333 Beverly Road is a different site.

warwick-capital-partners-decatur.note: I checked the final Illinois EPA construction permit issued October 14, 2026. It covers one turbine at 452 MW gross, the same as GEM. It is a power plant for the Archer Daniels Midland complex, not a backup fleet, so Backup Power no is right.

hut-8-hut-8-illinois-project-4-data-cent.note: The Data Center Dynamics article names a 50 MW Illinois Project 4 and no generator. I searched news and the Illinois EPA notices for gas generation and found none. It stays a watch item for no generating unit named.

powerhouse-data-centers-joliet.note: The Data Center Dynamics article describes grid substations and names no generator. I searched news and the Illinois EPA notices and found no on-site generation. It stays a watch item for no generating unit named.

monarch-rock-air-rockford.note: A Rock River Current article mentions associated power generation but names no fuel, engines or size. I searched news and the Illinois EPA notices and found no permit. It stays a watch item for no generating unit named.
